summary: Iteration 6 retest of the iteration 5 fixes. All fixes PASS. Backend: full suite 60 passed and 1 skipped. The skip is test_legacy_mistake_submit, which passed on the first run and then consumed the only legacy mistake on test-device-1dd0c1dc. 4 new TestIteration6 tests were added. HIGH, legacy mistakes: meta.version=7, and a DB check shows 47/47 mistakes match db.questions options/correct, with selected_index != correct for all. /api/quiz/mistakes for the legacy devices (dev_..fkmpywu6, dev_..yf98bs7p, test-device-1dd0c1dc, test1) matches /api/quiz exactly. Submitting the displayed correct answer on a legacy mistake returns correct:true and clears it. MEDIUM, device id: a fresh launch with IndexedDB/localStorage cleared directly on /progress fires /progress and /mistakes concurrently, and both use one device_id. The whole session (quiz + review + progress) used a single id. LOW, AI quiz: POST /api/quiz/generate returns shuffled options. The new batch had correct indices [3,2,1,1], the DB doc matches the response, and submitting correct returns true. LOW, laws: shows '1 norma in 1 area' for a single result and '32 norme in 10 aree' by default; ?focus=L. 1150/1942 auto-expands. Regression (390x844): in the edilizia quiz, 9 wrong answers gave 0%. In /quiz/errori, 9/9 mistakes were aligned and 9/9 correct answers gave 100%. The progress screen updates with 18 answered, 50% accuracy and the 'Nessun errore' empty state. Home, practice, library, tutor, simulation, flashcards and practice->quiz navigation all work, with no page errors and no 4xx/5xx API responses. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: Still returns question data copied into the mistakes collection instead of joining live db.questions. Currently aligned thanks to the v7 reseed, but any future content edit without a version bump will desync it again.

issues: A search with no matches shows only '0 norme in 0 aree' and no empty-state message (e.g. 'Nessuna norma trovata'). Cosmetic.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_mistakes_quiz remains denormalized. This is a fragility risk, not a current bug.
api.ts ensureDeviceId memoizes the in-flight promise correctly. If storage.getItem rejects, pendingId stays rejected for the session. This is an edge case and low risk.
